newsitem.title: USA: CSX, Norfolk in talks over Conrail.
newsitem.headline: CSX, Norfolk in talks over Conrail.

text.p: CSX Corp said it was holding talks with Norfolk Southern Corp about a possible sale of some material assets after its proposed merger with Conrail Inc.
CSX said in a statement it had told Conrail about the talks.
"No agreements have been reached and there can be no assurance that any agreements will be reached," it said without elaborating.

Although CSX and Conrail have entered into an $8.4 billion merger pact, Norfolk made a rival bid for $8.8 billion two weeks ago and filed a suit to try to stop the two railroad companies from merging.
